evidence: provider documentation and crit-labs' own source; calls, formats and GPUs are as the providers state them, not measured by crit unless a kernel says so

operations.what: a token drawn from a row's processed law (temperature, top-k, top-p, min-p) on the device
operations.verify: on the target, draw many tokens from fixed rows with the kernel and compare their frequencies with law's probabilities (a chi-square or the sampling check crit eval runs); provider draws use their own random stream, so they are not bit-equal to Core's counter-based Philox draws that this entry's kernels reproduce

kernels.shapes: any vocabulary; per-row parameters as tensors
kernels.notes: not counter-based: replies are not reproducible from a seed the way Core's sampler is, which speculative verification with Core's draws needs
